grandparents_cupboard.reason: Corn, pepper, spring onions, tomatoes, eggs, feta, chives and bread are all plain home foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every item is an everyday Tesco purchase, and corn cobs are cheap and plentiful in late September.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large lidded frying pan and a toaster, and the technique is simple frying and baking eggs in hollows.

works.reason: Three cobs, 300g tomatoes and eight eggs make a sensible two-eggs-each pan for four, and the covered 6 to 8 minutes will set the whites.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is believable for stripping three cobs, slicing a pepper and spring onions and halving the tomatoes, and 15 cook minutes roughly matches the 16 to 18 minutes in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Fresh garden sweetcorn at its late September peak forms the base of the dish rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, vegetables, feta and wholemeal toast make a filling, balanced family breakfast.
